title: Frustrated customer, routine case
message: This is ridiculous. ORD-5501 shows delivered but I am not sure the tracking is right. Sort it out.
assistant_text:
CASE FACTS
- Customer: Mei Lin Tan, C-1001 (verified, status: pending)
- ORD-5501: Ceramic table lamp, $120.00
- Placed: 2026-10-01; shipped: yes; ETA: 2026-10-06
- Status: delivered; charges: 1 (no duplicate)
- Damage photo on file: yes

Resolution: Our order record shows ORD-5501 as shipped and delivered, with an ETA of 2026-10-06. It was charged once. I can only see the status in our system, not the carrier's scan history, so I can't confirm the tracking details beyond that.

If you did not receive the lamp, or it arrived damaged, please tell me which. A damage photo is already on file for this order. If the lamp is damaged, I can review a refund of $120.00 under our damage policy. If you have a different concern, tell me what it is and I'll look into it.
